how: Members call for help drawing the flag and make participation conditional on gathering enough hands
Manpower doubts accompany offers to try rather than necessarily stopping the initial build
An unfamiliar participant asks what the canvas is and receives an explanation while recruitment is underway
Bare participation reports receive bare thanks without a further request
Calling, beginning a background and supplying a template distribute starting work across several participants
Participants disagree over adding Chinese wording and keeping or removing HK letters without establishing a collective reversal
Coordinates, a shared pixel template and a corner anchor make the proposed flag actionable
Participants report starting the red background and doing their part in the build
Moving planning into chat requires opening access, repairing invitations and relaying plans back around posting delays
An open request for an anchor decision and a later reported decision leave the unseen chat's decision procedures unresolved
A participation report and credit for chat helpers establish neither machine placement nor its absence
Members call for defence and continued checking after the flag is established
An offer from overseas friends answers the problem of local participants sleeping without establishing a formal night shift
A participant attributes reclamation to the host group while the record leaves the actual placers unverified
Insufficient capacity and neighbour conflict stop an optional extension while helpers may continue later or assist the neighbour
Participants seek building space and later negotiate around a neighbouring logo move
Builders report permission to occupy host territory and choose it for expected security before announcing completion
Reported permission supports guest entry but leaves promised protection and enforceable host authority unresolved
A participant carries the host chat's permission back to the flag builders
Permission and anticipated security direct the proposed build toward host territory before completion
Builders shrink the template by three rows expressly to avoid overwriting neighbouring work
Participants credit neighbouring helpers without specifying a reciprocal exchange or their share of the labour
An alliance question receives confirmation of permission rather than mutual defence obligations
The report that builders missed the memo does not establish refusal of an agreement or a dispute over who speaks for them
A proposal for FREEHK gives a narrow political expression without supplying a history-based explanation of the canvas effort
Political wording and dislike of a letter do not identify an inherited quarrel carried into the canvas
The FREEHK proposal supplies no pre-existing tie naming a rival as the reason to attack
Calling the canvas an April Fools game does not establish a host subreddit prank or takeover
Surviving invitation and placement titles do not disclose whether removed bodies reflected a canvas-posting rule
Participants announce establishment, congratulate helpers and thank contributions
A closing comment reports that the flag survived perfectly after placement ended
The closing survival report and later account of missing the effort establish no decision to continue the organisation or reuse its mark
Reporting the flag still perfect after closure neither contests a preserved version nor requests cleanup
The reported red column establishes possible encroachment but leaves its builders' relation to the room and their purpose unresolved
The visible conflict is answered through a request for agreement and an invitation to help the neighbour rather than evidenced taunting or victory claims
Alternative coordinates and redirected expansion do not establish relocation after the established flag was erased or overrun
A direct answer to the drawing call requests coordinates and reports starting the background
A mark proposal and recruitment can be the same utterance rather than two separately ordered stages
The explicit transition from success to defending against mismatched dots ties upkeep to an established mark
Negotiation can precede completion because builders seek permission for a secure construction site rather than only defending an existing mark
Permission and template restraint share an exchange but the stated reason for shrinking is avoiding neighbouring art rather than an evidenced treaty obligation
Visible defence calls leave the helpers' placement methods unknown and cannot establish maintenance causing automation
A reported contribution receives direct thanks, linking building participation to recognition
Establishment celebrations and a later survival report show sequence without explaining celebration as the cause of recording
The closing report and later missed-participation account reveal no continuation decision whose dependence on recording could be tested
Too few hands can stop optional expansion and redirect help while leaving the established core distinct from any proposed move
Templates coordinate provisional designs without necessarily settling later additions or disputes over lettering
Accepting a call can request coordinates or explain manpower conditions rather than supplying a bare answer
Overseas help and thanks to neighbouring helpers do not establish that upkeep shortages caused inter-room assistance
Permission followed by thanks for outside help leaves the terms of any reciprocal bargain unobserved
An extension call and a later red-column report leave unresolved whether recruitment produced an attack on a rival
An abort explained by conflict and limited manpower does not establish a refusal answering an attack call
Negotiation around expansion is visible but an intentional attack causing that negotiation remains unresolved
An encroachment report and an agreement request do not establish an attack followed by a rival-facing contest in talk
Expected security and credited help reveal no completed coalition agreement caused by maintenance pressure
Calls for helpers and surviving placement titles leave any causal chain through a canvas-posting flood and host regulation unresolved
Negotiation and missed communication do not show members challenging anyone's right to commit the room
